## Problem

What's the user-facing problem? "I want to do X but the SDK can't because Y."

## Proposed solution

The shape of the change you have in mind (new flag? new module? change to `agora_core`?).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they're worse.

## Does this affect the wire protocol?

- [ ] No (client-only change)
- [ ] Yes (needs coordinated server-side change — see [PROTOCOL.md](../../PROTOCOL.md))

## Additional context

Anything else.
